name: slider-track-corner
negative_note: issue #50 — the software renderer quantizes element geometry to integer device pixels; fractional track edges diverge up to ~1 device px. skia/femtovg at 2x additionally diverge on the 20px corner-override slider: Slint's cross-renderer model clamps each corner independently to half the shorter side (#47 connected-button semantics), while the Android RoundRect the Compose reference draws through scales all radii proportionally — the gap-side cap edge shifts ~1 device px on the overflow corner
